title: Get GitHub Achievements
meta_description: Free step-by-step guides with screenshots for earning every GitHub achievement badge: Quickdraw, YOLO, Pull Shark, Pair Extraordinaire, Starstruck, Galaxy Brain and Public Sponsor.
og_description: Learn how to earn every GitHub achievement badge, one screenshot at a time.
lede: Achievements are the badges GitHub pins to your profile when you do certain things, like merging pull requests or answering questions. This site shows you exactly how to earn each one.
progress_hint: Tick them off as you go (saved in this browser).
ach_intro: Seven badges you can earn today, ordered from quickest to hardest. Open a guide to see every step.
req_quickdraw: Close an issue or pull request within 5 minutes of opening it.
req_yolo: Merge a pull request without a review, even though a reviewer was requested.
req_pair: Co-author a commit in a pull request that gets merged. You and your co-author both earn it.
req_starstruck: Own a repository that reaches 16 stars. It still counts if you later transfer the repository.
req_galaxy: Get 2 of your answers accepted in a public repository's Discussions.
req_sponsor: Sponsor an open-source developer through GitHub Sponsors.
tiers_pull_shark: Higher tiers at 16, 128 and 1024 merged pull requests.
tiers_pair: Higher tiers at 10, 24 and 48 co-authored merged pull requests.
tiers_galaxy: Higher tiers at 8, 16 and 32 accepted answers.
tip_coauthor: Prefer the command line? Add this line at the end of your commit message instead:
tip_galaxy: Heads up: answers in GitHub's own Community forum no longer count. GitHub turned achievements off there.
more_intro: Achievements that are still in testing or can no longer be earned, plus the highlight badges GitHub shows for special programs.
testing_text: Still being tested by GitHub. A guide will follow once it's officially released.
mars_text: Given for code in a repository used by the Mars 2020 helicopter mission.
arctic_text: Given for code in a repository saved by the 2020 GitHub Archive Program.
hl_bounty: Help find vulnerabilities through GitHub Security.
hl_advisory: Get a security advisory accepted into the GitHub Advisory Database.
skin_text: Some badges, like Quickdraw and Starstruck, follow your emoji skin tone. Change it in your appearance settings.
skin_alt: Quickdraw badge in every skin tone
hide_text: Not into badges? You can turn off achievements on your profile from your profile settings.
docs_text: For the official rules, see GitHub's docs on displaying badges on your profile.
fair_text: This guide is here to teach you how achievements work. Please respect GitHub's Terms of Service and community guidelines: don't spam other projects just to collect badges. The best way to earn them is to take part in real projects and help other people.
langs_intro: This site is available in 19 languages, translated by the community.
footer_credit: Guide content and images from 4xmen/Get-Github-Achievements (GPL-3.0). Found a mistake? Report it.
